name: Scholze, Perfectoid spaces, Theorem 3.7(i)
scope: Every finite extension of a perfectoid field is perfectoid. The actual field E_L is proved to equal the finite compositum LE_0 inside C.

name: Bhatt–Morrow–Scholze, Integral p-adic Hodge theory, Definition 3.5 and Example 3.6
scope: Completion of integers in an algebraic extension of Qp containing the cyclotomic tower is perfectoid. FET3 proves the precise sharp expansion used here.
